```{r}
xlsx2csv <- function(f) {
    fout = gsub(".xlsx", ".csv", f)
    d = read_xlsx(f)
    fwrite(d, fout, bom=TRUE)
}

xlsx2csv("./GRA_那曲_高寒草甸_2014-2018_30min_Flux.xlsx")
xlsx2csv("./GRA_那曲_高寒草甸_2014-2018_30min_Met.xlsx")
```
